_note: The campaign's continents on Tellus Nova (Content.continents(); D-418..D-422; Overworld plan row F3). Placeholder rows: the names, stages, order and Threat shares are ruled, the bonus ids are stand-ins until the director picks the bonuses (D-421: the plan's lists are proposals). In the globe's fixed sequence (D-420): Ostia Minor first, then the two lowest unconquered of Carthago..Neptunia are offered; the capital is last. id: the save's key (SaveFile campaign conquered/bonuses). stage: the growth stage the city plays at, an index of tuning growth.stages (0 young, 1 Behemoth, 2 Colossus; D-419). threat: Threat Level percent its conquest adds (D-422; the six sum to 80, in-mission noise adds the rest, capped at 99). bonuses: the three bonuses its conquest offers, the player keeps one (D-421); none for the capital. Each: id (the save's bonuses value) and scale, stat -> fraction added to that stat after upgrades (0.15 = +15%; picks on one stat add before multiplying; UpgradeTree.apply, plan row F4). Only Ostia Minor's three carry test scales; the rest are {} until the bonuses are picked. stage_words: the stages in game words by index, as the mission panel names them (plan row G5). bonus_lines: each bonus stat as a phrase with its percent inside (%d, D-432: 'Moves 10% faster', not '+10% Moves faster'); every stat a bonus scales needs one. capital: Aurelia, opened when the sixth conquest sets Threat to 100 (D-422). real_city (optional, D-454): LAUNCH starts this continent's real city at its stage (true for Ostia Minor, Carthago and Thule); without it LAUNCH opens the stand-in WIN / LOSE mission. tuning (optional): keys over the stage's tuning, section by section, for this continent's city (CityGrowth.tuning_for, D-435): Ostia Minor plays today's beach, bay and river as tuned; Carthago a round harbour mid-city (layout kind cothon) with one 14 m canal south to the map edge and two 13 deg spokes meeting at a plaza; Thule a narrow fjord through ice lengthways (kind fjord) among rough, uneven blocks; each sets its own landmark_spots (one a quadrant, the same sizes as Ostia's); the rest the default plan for now.

landmark_spots._note: C1 (D-435, D-436): one spot a quadrant, 150 m+ apart and clear of the harbour, its canal and the map edge: west (the stadium's) north-west and east (the wheel's) north-east, medium; big south-east and biggest south-west, either side of the canal.

C1 (D-435, D-436): one spot a quadrant, 150 m+ apart and clear of the fjord and the map edge: west (the stadium's) and east (the wheel's) face each other across the fjord in the north, medium; big on the east bank and biggest on the west bank in the south.
